name: Valproic acid
summary: Valproic acid is an antiseizure medication also used as a mood stabilizer. Sodium valproate and divalproex are related formulations; record the product and its stated units without assuming equal masses.
generalRisks: This entry does not contain a complete risk or interaction assessment. Missing information or an absent interaction warning does not mean that a substance or combination is safe.
metabolism: Almost entirely metabolized in the liver, mainly by glucuronidation and mitochondrial beta-oxidation, with smaller oxidative pathways. Very little valproate is eliminated unchanged in urine.
